data.body: Confirmation by hash, from the sweeps of runs 44487190183 and 44503581058: the Windows result `550e37cbee00c5f27e69148954b33e5b7ddb57f0` is exactly the git blob hash of `café ✓\r\n`, and the expected `6b2b281e1146f9673f218f9c76042db37be95d03` is the hash of `café ✓\n` (computed locally as sha1 over `blob <len>\0<bytes>`). So the only difference is newline translation in text-mode stdin; the UTF-8 encoding is right. The source is 04e175d70eb (livid-painful-mosquito, closed), not the A1 stack. A duplicate filed by mistake (metalled-oceangoing-antlion) has been closed against this ticket.
